# rustinion_group_hardening (Resource)

Manages a group's hardening benchmarks: CIS-style checks (SSH, accounts, kernel network settings, permissions, firewall, updates, logging) run by the agent on Linux, Windows, macOS and OpenWrt; each device gets a score and a list of failing checks with remediation. Checks only read; nothing is changed on the device. Destroying this resource turns the checks off.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) The group these settings belong to.

### Optional

- `accepted_risks` (List of String) Checks you accept, as `policy_id | check_id | reason`; they leave the score. Default none.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Run the checks in the group. Default true (the resource exists to turn them on).
- `interval_hours` (Number) Hours between scans (1 to 336). Default 24.
- `min_score` (Number) Raise a finding (summary email) when a device scores below this percentage. Unset = never.
- `policies` (List of String) Policy ids to run: shipped (`rustinion_debian_ubuntu_hardening`, `rustinion_rhel_hardening`, `rustinion_windows_hardening`, `rustinion_macos_hardening`, `rustinion_openwrt_hardening`) or imported. Empty = every shipped policy; each applies only to the operating systems it is written for.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as group_id.
